name: grid-ops-console
description: A real-time operations console for monitoring grid assets and dispatching demand response events.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
